narration: आज पारो को दीवार पर खरगोश चाहिए, वरना नींद नहीं आती। वह बिस्तर पर घुटनों के बल बैठी है।
caption: Tonight Paro wants a rabbit on the wall, or sleep will not come.
image_brief: Paro, a four-year-old girl in a yellow kurta with two short braids, kneeling on a low wooden bed in a small bedroom, facing a bare cream wall, a small lamp glowing on a shelf behind her.

narration: रात हो चुकी है। कमरा शांत है। दीवार बिलकुल खाली है।
caption: Night has settled in. The room is quiet. The wall is completely bare.
image_brief: The whole bedroom seen from the open doorway: two low beds, a bare cream wall, a shelf lamp throwing a warm pool of light, one dark window.

narration: पारो अपने दोनों हाथ जोड़ती है। दो उँगलियाँ सीधी ऊपर उठाती है।
caption: Paro brings both hands together and lifts two fingers straight up.
image_brief: Only Paro's two small hands, fingers laced together with two fingers raised, held up in warm lamp light.

narration: ये खरगोश के कान हैं। लैंप की रोशनी सीधे उन पर पड़ती है।
caption: These are rabbit ears. The lamp light falls right on them.
image_brief: Paro's hands from behind her shoulder, two raised fingers standing like ears against the lit wall ahead of her.

narration: पारो की दीवार पर एक नन्ही छाया उभरती है। बस अंगूठे जितनी बड़ी।
caption: A tiny shadow appears on Paro's wall. Only as big as her thumb.
image_brief: The bare cream wall alone, with one thumb-sized rabbit shadow near its middle, warm light washing the rest of the plaster.

narration: पारो दो बार ताली बजाती है और कहती है, दो ताली, एक खरगोश!
caption: Paro claps twice and says, two claps, one rabbit!
image_brief: Paro's face and open palms mid-clap, her mouth shaped in speech, lamp light on one cheek, the dark room behind her.

narration: छाया हिलती है। कान फड़फड़ाते हैं। पारो धीरे से हँसती है।
caption: The shadow moves. The ears flap. Paro laughs softly.
image_brief: The small rabbit shadow on the wall with its ears tipped sideways, and Paro's hands at the very edge of the frame.

narration: पर यह खरगोश बहुत छोटा है। पारो को बड़ा चाहिए।
caption: But this rabbit is far too small. Paro wants a big one.
image_brief: Paro sitting back on her heels on the bed, shoulders dropped, staring at the wall where the tiny shadow sits.

narration: पारो को दरवाज़े जितना बड़ा खरगोश चाहिए। कान छत तक पहुँचें।
caption: Paro wants a rabbit as big as the door. Ears that reach the ceiling.
image_brief: The tall closed bedroom door, with Paro standing beside it and stretching one hand up toward the ceiling to measure it.

narration: पारो ने दीदी से छोटा लैंप माँगा। दीदी ने तुरंत दे दिया।
caption: Paro asked her big sister for the small lamp. She handed it over at once.
image_brief: Paro's older sister standing by the bed holding out a small clip-on lamp, Paro's hands rising to take it, warm light between them.

narration: अब लैंप तकिए के पास है। रोशनी पारो के हाथ में है।
caption: Now the lamp sits by the pillow. The light is in Paro's hands.
image_brief: The small lamp resting on the mattress beside a flat pillow, its light spilling across the sheet and over Paro's fingers.

narration: फिर भी पारो का खरगोश उतना ही छोटा है। अंगूठे जितना।
caption: Still Paro's rabbit stays just as small. Thumb sized.
image_brief: The cream wall with the same thumb-sized rabbit shadow on it, and the lamp now glowing close by on the bed below.

narration: तुम भी दो ताली बजाओ। पारो ने भी बजाईं, दो बार।
caption: You clap twice too. Paro clapped as well, two times.
image_brief: Paro clapping with her hands wide apart, the bedcover rumpled around her knees, lamp light coming low from one side.

narration: पारो सोचती है, लैंप को दीवार के पास ले जाऊँ।
caption: Paro thinks, let me carry the lamp closer to the wall.
image_brief: Paro on hands and knees at the edge of the bed, both hands gripping the lamp's base, her eyes on the wall.

narration: पारो लैंप को घसीटकर दीवार से सटा देती है।
caption: Paro drags the lamp until it touches the wall.
image_brief: The lamp pushed right up against the cream wall, its paper shade almost touching the plaster, Paro's hand still on it.
